# hn

> Hacker News in your terminal: interactive browser, scriptable CLI, and agent-friendly JSON. macOS and Linux. Rust.

Repository: https://github.com/kaushalvivek/hn-cli
Agent guide: https://github.com/kaushalvivek/hn-cli/blob/main/AGENTS.md
Releases: https://github.com/kaushalvivek/hn-cli/releases

## Install

- Linux, any distro: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kaushalvivek/hn-cli/main/install.sh | sh`
- Linux native packages: `.deb`, `.rpm`, Arch `.pkg.tar.zst`, and Alpine `.apk` on the Releases page
- macOS: `brew install kaushalvivek/tap/hn`
- Cargo: `cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/kaushalvivek/hn-cli`

## Use

- Interactive: `hn` or `hn browse [--feed front|new|best|ask|show|jobs|active|comments]`
- Discover commands: `hn capabilities`
- JSON on every command: add `--json` (or set `HN_JSON=1`)
- Read feeds: `hn front --limit 10 --json`, `hn new --json`, `hn ask --json`, `hn show --json`, `hn jobs --json`
- Read items: `hn item <id> --json`, `hn thread <id> --json`, `hn context <comment-id> --json`
- Search: `hn search "<query>" [--type story|comment|all] [--sort relevance|date] --json`
- Users: `hn user <username> [--activity submissions|comments|favorites|upvoted|hidden] --json`
- Meta: `hn leaders --json`, `hn updates --json`, `hn past [YYYY-MM-DD] --json`, `hn from <domain> --json`
- Auth: `printf '%s\n' "$HN_PASSWORD" | hn login --username USER --password-stdin`, `hn whoami --json`, `hn logout`

Writes require an explicit user request: `hn vote`, `hn submit`, `hn comment`, `hn edit`, `hn delete`, `hn favorite`, `hn hide`, `hn flag`, `hn unflag`.

Submission: `hn submit --title "..." --url https://example.com`, `hn submit --title "..." --text "..."`, or interactive `hn submit`. `hn submit --use-draft` resumes a saved submission. TUI: press `s` for a title/link/text form.

## Contract

- stdout is data; stderr is diagnostics.
- Exit code 0 = success, 1 = error.
- JSON errors: `{"ok":false,"error":{"code":"...","message":"..."}}`.
- Raw HTML fields (`title`, `text`, `about`) must be rendered or stripped by the consumer.
- Session: `~/.config/hn/session.json` (0600). Never print or transmit it.
- Public reads need no account. Do not perform writes without explicit intent.

## Development

- `cargo test`
- `cargo check`
- `cargo fmt`
- `cargo build --release`

Library crate: `hn_cli`. Binary: `hn`.
